summary: Reads text or table data from disk or a web URL into a DAT, with optional conversion from tab-delimited text to table cells.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Path or http URL to load into the DAT

key_params.name: converttable
key_params.note: Convert tab-delimited text into table rows and columns

key_params.name: refresh
key_params.note: Reload when the source file changes

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: .dat files load as table data while other files are treated as raw text unless Convert to Table is enabled.
Remote http sources can cook asynchronously or fail, so generated networks should include missing-data handling.
Refresh behavior is explicit; file edits are not always reflected until refresh or recook depending on settings.
Use File In DAT for text and tables, not for binary media metadata or image/video pixels.
key_concepts: Reads text or DAT table files from disk into a DAT operator.
Can load from an http URL as documented by the File parameter.
Convert Table turns tab-delimited text into table rows and columns.
Refresh controls whether file contents are reloaded automatically or by pulse.
